Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I would like to request a table for 12 people for next Friday, May 24, 2024.

Could you please let me know if a private dining table for a party of 12 is available on that date? If so, I would appreciate any information about menu options or arrangements for a group of this size.

Thank you very much for your assistance. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson

Phone: 327-420-4923
